items.title: Human: Recipe Finding
items.description:
• Scroll endless blogs, cookbooks, family recipes.
• Ingredient substitutions are a nightmare.
• Intuitive sense for what 'looks good'.

items.title: AI: Recipe Finding
items.description:
• Generates recipes instantly based on criteria.
• Suggests substitutions, adjusts portions easily.
• Lacks emotional connection to food memories.

items.title: Human: Job Searching
items.description:
• Hours scrolling job boards, tailoring resumes.
• Missing hidden gems, feeling overwhelmed.
• Networking and building real connections.

items.title: AI: Job Searching
items.description:
• Scans thousands of listings, customizes docs.
• Finds niche jobs, optimizes resume keywords.
• Lacks intuition for cultural fit or 'vibe'.

items.title: Human: Photo Editing
items.description:
• Manual adjustments; takes time to learn software.
• Inconsistent results; easily overwhelmed by options.
• Applies unique creative vision and emotional depth.

items.title: AI: Photo Editing
items.description:
• Instant fixes: removes objects, enhances colors fast.
• Automates repetitive tasks with high consistency.
• Lacks artistic judgment; can over-process images.

items.title: Human: Budget Planning
items.description:
• Manual tracking, often tedious and time-consuming.
• Forgetting expenses; emotional spending decisions.
• Adapts to life changes; understands personal values.

items.title: AI: Budget Planning
items.description:
• Analyzes spending patterns; suggests savings fast.
• Identifies trends and potential overspending quickly.
• Limited by data; no empathy for real-life situations.

items.title: Human: Learning a Lang
items.description:
• Years of study, inconsistent practice, slow progress.
• Fear of speaking, forgetting grammar, limited immersion.
• Real-time cultural nuance, emotional connection, fluency.

items.title: AI: Learning a Languag
items.description:
• Instant translations, grammar checks, practice scenarios.
• Consistent feedback, vast vocabulary, custom lessons.
• Lacks real conversation flow, cultural depth, empathy.

items.title: Human: Tax Filing Help
items.description:
• Hours of document gathering, complex forms, high stress.
• Calculation errors, missing deductions, audit anxiety.
• Expert advice for complex cases, personal financial plan.

items.title: AI: Tax Filing Help
items.description:
• Quick calculation, form population, basic deduction tips.
• Automates data entry, identifies common deductions fast.
• No legal advice, can't verify external data, privacy risk.

items.title: Human: Trip Planning
items.description:
• Hours of research, comparing flights & hotels manually.
• Overwhelmed by choices, missing deals, forgetting details.
• Intuitive understanding of personal preferences & mood.

items.title: AI: Trip Planning
items.description:
• Generates itineraries, suggests activities in seconds.
• Rapidly sifts through vast amounts of location data.
• Lacks real-time pricing; can 'hallucinate' places.

items.title: Human: Email Drafting
items.description:
• Takes time to find right words, proofread, ensure tone.
• Writer's block, typos, unclear messages, wrong tone.
• Genuine empathy, nuanced emotional understanding, personal

items.title: AI: Email Drafting
items.description:
• Drafts emails quickly for various purposes and tones.
• Ensures grammar, spelling, and consistent professional tone.
• Can sound generic or lack true human emotion/context.

items.title: Human: Debugging Code
items.description:
• Hours spent staring at screens, manual trial & error.
• Overlooking simple typos, getting stuck on complex logic.
• Deep contextual understanding, intuition for obscure bugs.

items.title: AI: Debugging Code
items.description:
• Scans code fast, suggests fixes in seconds.
• Identifies common errors, syntax issues, logical flaws.
• Struggles with novel issues, complex system interactions.

items.title: Human: Meal Planning
items.description:
• Time-consuming research, balancing tastes & nutrition.
• Forgetting ingredients, repetitive meals, wasted food.
• Adapts to real-time cravings, emotional preferences.

items.title: AI: Meal Planning
items.description:
• Generates diverse plans quickly based on criteria.
• Considers diet, allergies, budget, calorie count easily.
• Lacks intuition for mood, specific fresh produce

items.title: Human: Resume Writing
items.description:
• Hours spent agonizing over wording and formatting.
• Misses keywords; hard to tailor for each job.
• Deeply understands personal story, career goals.

items.title: AI: Resume Writing
items.description:
• Drafts quickly, suggests tailored content in minutes.
• Optimizes keywords for Applicant Tracking Systems.
• Lacks personal touch; can sound generic or fake.

items.title: Human: Translating Text
items.description:
• Time-consuming; requires fluency and cultural insight.
• Can miss subtle nuances, cultural context, idioms.
• Captures emotion, tone, and cultural subtleties.

items.title: AI: Translating Text
items.description:
• Instant translation of large texts, many languages.
• Handles repetitive, factual text with high speed.
• Struggles with slang, humor, deep cultural context.
